QuestInfo.name: Dress For Cygnus
QuestInfo.0: Kimu says any Empress needs the perfect dress to impress.\r\nSounds pretty convincing. Talk to Kimu.
QuestInfo.1: Head out to find materials for the dress.\r\n#b(Talk to Kiriru to go to Aqua Road.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You headed out to find materials for the dress.

0.0: For generations we've always used special materials to make the Empress's dress. You can't express her mystical and graceful nature with simple fabric and dye.
0.1: We'll need pearls for this job. #bAqua Road White Pearls, Aqua Road Green Pearls, and Aqua Road Black Pearls#k. Imagine those glinting baubles on the lovely Cygnus! It sounds so glorious.

yes.0: You can only get these materials in Aqua Road. So, off with you! \r\n#b(Talk to Kiriru to go to Aqua Road.)#k

no.0: Don't you want to see Cygnus in her new dress as soon as possible?

1.0: Wow! I've never seen the ocean so close! So much water, it's kind of insane!

yes.0: Oh yeah, we're here on a mission! I almost forgot.

npc.0: You can only get these materials in Aqua Road. So, off to Aqua Road with you!\r\n#b(Talk to Kiriru to go to Aqua Road.)#k
